title: Portfolio holdout — raw model and guarded decisions
dataset_label: 20 frozen stress-oriented holdout questions; separate from all earlier runs

results.label: Local Qwen with validation and bounded repair

limitations: All 20 cases are medium/hard, fictional, assistant-authored and assistant-reviewed; no human annotation.
Rules are a deterministic baseline, not LLM accuracy.
Raw Qwen: 7/20. Accepted final decisions: 3/20; conservative grounding rejects some correct answers.
The policy blocks execution but does not guarantee semantic correctness; no production-readiness claim.
Decision-only evaluation disables simulated tool execution; execution guards are checked in tests.
Model evaluation resumed after an interruption: first six cases preserved byte-for-byte, remaining fourteen generated once.
Reported model time sums active case runtimes and excludes the idle interruption.
No fine-tuning or model weight changes; previous smoke/development percentages use different questions.
